message.bending.unknown_element: Unknown element. Use fire, water, earth or air.
message.bending.level_up: Bending level %s! You earned a skill point (press B to spend it).
message.bending.innate: %s is innate: it's always ready in bending mode and doesn't need a slot.
message.bending.calm_mind: Your mind isn't calm enough for lightning
screen.bending.loadout.title: %s Loadout
screen.bending.loadout.innate: Innate: always ready in bending mode
screen.bending.loadout.click_unequip: Equipped. Click to empty this slot
screen.bending.loadout.locked: Locked: unlock it in the skill tree
screen.bending.loadout.hint: Click an ability to equip it. Press B or Esc to close.
screen.bending.loadout.hint_creative: Creative mode: locked abilities can be equipped for testing. Press B or Esc to close.
screen.bending.cast.charge: Hold to charge, release to fire
ability.bending.fire_blast.desc: A quick fire strike: punches and kicks in a combo. Two hits take down most mobs. It scorches, but never breaks blocks. Hold Ctrl on the ground to do a spinning leg sweep instead, throwing a ring of fire around you; hold Ctrl in mid-air for a stamping kick that slams a crescent of fire into the ground ahead.
ability.bending.fire_jet_dash.desc: An explosive burst launches you the way you're pressing, tilted by your aim. Keep holding Ctrl to ride the jets and steer.
ability.bending.meteor_slam.desc: Dive like a meteor where you look and hit in a ring of fire. The higher you start, the harder it hits; from above dash height it explodes.
ability.bending.fire_arc.desc: A spinning kick sends out a crescent of fire 7 blocks wide that sweeps 18 blocks forward, burning everything it passes through.
ability.bending.fire_shield.desc: Hold: a disc of flame that burns up projectiles and scorches attackers. Tap: Flame Burst, a ring of fire that knocks everything back.
ability.bending.flame_parry.desc: A split-second block. Anything that hits you from the front in that window is burned back, and you regain chi.
ability.bending.jet_propulsion.desc: Sustained flight on fire jets. Fly where you look; sneak to hover. Drains chi fast.
ability.bending.firestorm.desc: Gather fire for a second, then erupt: a cratering blast, a ring of explosions and a flaming vortex.
ability.bending.combustion_beam.desc: Focus fire into one point, then fire an instant explosive beam. More charge means more damage and a bigger blast.
ability.bending.lightning.desc: Charge with a calm mind to store 4 bolts of lightning, crackling around you. While they last, Fire Blast throws a bolt instead of a fireball: 20 damage, chaining to 2 more targets for 10. Getting hit while charging breaks it.
screen.bending.skill_tree.title: %s Skill Tree
screen.bending.skill_tree.learned_abilit: Learned: equip it in the Loadout tab
screen.bending.skill_tree.need_points: Not enough skill points: land hits with your bending to level up
screen.bending.skill_tree.need_previous: Learn a skill connected to it first
screen.bending.skill_tree.hint: Click a glowing skill to learn it. Drag to move, scroll to zoom. Every level gives a skill point.
screen.bending.skill_tree.hint_creative: Creative: skills are free. Drag to move, scroll to zoom. B or Esc closes.
skill.bending.blue_fire.desc: All your fire burns blue, like Azula's. +25% damage, and burns last longer.
skill.bending.breath_of_fire.desc: Running out of chi no longer stops you: you keep bending by burning hunger instead (1 hunger point per 10 chi, down to your last point).
skill.bending.dancing_dragon.desc: The original form. +50% chi regen during the day, and back-to-back hits build a combo: +5% damage per hit, up to 5 stacks. 3 s without a hit resets it.
skill.bending.lightning_redirection.desc: Iroh's technique. While you hold Fire Shield facing it, incoming lightning (a bender's bolt or a lightning strike) runs through you and fires back where you look, refunding 30 chi.
ability.bending.fireball_charge.desc: Hold to build a fireball between your hands, release to throw it. It explodes on impact; the longer you charge (up to 2 s), the bigger the ball, the damage and the blast. Unlike Fire Blast, it blows holes in the terrain.
ability.bending.dragons_breath.desc: Hold to breathe a torrent of billowing fire 50 blocks long and about 40 across at the far end, following your aim. Everything in it burns and gets pushed back, and the ground catches fire. Up to 5 s per breath.
ability.bending.blazing_leap.desc: Hold on the ground to build up, release to blast off on fire jets: a tap hops about 6 blocks, a full 1 s charge launches you about 20 blocks up and forward. The take-off burns anyone next to you, and you take no fall damage.
ability.bending.wall_of_fire.desc: Raise a wall of flame 3 blocks in front of you, 14 wide and 4.5 tall, for 6 s, with jets of fire bursting out of the ground. It burns up every projectile that tries to cross it, scorches and shoves back anything that walks into it, and leaves the ground burning.
message.bending.loadout_combat: You can't change your loadout in combat.
screen.bending.loadout.combat: In combat: your loadout is locked until you're out of the fight for 5 seconds.
skill.bending.wildfire.desc: Everything you set alight burns much longer.
skill.bending.deep_lungs.desc: Breathe deeper and hold more chi.
skill.bending.inner_calm.desc: Your chi starts coming back sooner after you bend.
skill.bending.inner_fire.desc: The heart of your bending. Everything grows out from here.
skill.bending.vitality.desc: Your inner fire hardens your body.
skill.bending.iron_body.desc: Shrug off a share of every hit.
skill.bending.blast_velocity.desc: Faster fireballs, so they fly further too.
skill.bending.heavy_shot.desc: Fire Blast style. Each fireball hits much harder but flies slower. Locks out Rapid Shot.
skill.bending.rapid_shot.desc: Fire Blast style. Fireballs cost far less chi, so you can keep the barrage going. Locks out Heavy Shot.
skill.bending.wide_maw.desc: Dragon's Breath style. The torrent fans out far wider. Locks out Long Breath.
skill.bending.long_breath.desc: Dragon's Breath style. A tighter torrent that reaches much further. Locks out Wide Maw.
skill.bending.afterburner.desc: Jet Dash style. A violent burst of speed. Locks out Long Burn.
skill.bending.long_burn.desc: Jet Dash style. Ride the jets far longer before they give out. Locks out Afterburner.
skill.bending.forked.desc: Lightning style. Every bolt chains to 2 more targets. Locks out Overcharge.
skill.bending.overcharge.desc: Lightning style. A full charge stores 2 extra bolts. Locks out Forked Lightning.
screen.bending.skill_tree.click_rank: Click to learn the next rank
death.attack.bending.firebending: %1$s was burned to a crisp by %2$s's firebending
death.attack.bending.firebending.item: %1$s was burned to a crisp by %2$s's firebending
gui.bending.extract_warning: Pull every gem out. Each has a %s%% chance to shatter.
tooltip.bending.gem_hint: Socket into armor at an Imbuing Altar
tooltip.bending.warlord_ember: Use on the ground to call the Fire Warlord
message.bending.warlord_arrives: The Fire Warlord has come to test you.
message.bending.warlord_defeated: The Fire Warlord falls. +%s skill points
ability.bending.heat_siphon.desc: Hold to draw every flame around you into your body: fires go out, burning creatures are put out, fire projectiles are swallowed, fire that hits you is absorbed, and magma and lava are drained (magma cools to cobblestone after 2 s, lava to obsidian after 8 s). Once you're full, heat sources feed you chi instead. Let go to blast the stored heat out in a ring; the more you absorbed, the bigger and harder it hits.
